QuestInfo.name: [Lunar New Year Mission] Deliver Ullan's Message
QuestInfo.0: Talk to Ullan again to get the finished message.
QuestInfo.1: Ullan's message is for her father, #bKan#k. You'll find him in Kaptafel by #btaking the caravan from El Nath#k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered Ullan's message to #bKan#k, who reminisces about happy day spent with her when she was young. She's changed so much!

default.0: You can go straight to Kaptafel by taking the caravan from El Nath! You can't miss the huge Shrelephant there.
